remarks: Rolling Ridge is one of the most coveted condominium communities in Norwalk. The attractive Tudor style buildings are located in the West Rocks area. This top floor end unit affords stunning wooded views overlooking a picturesque pond and the sounds of nature from a private balcony. Unit features: living room/dining area with ample space for comfort and entertaining; an updated kitchen, including new LG refrigerator, along with an oversized sink, ample counter space and stainless steel appliances; large ensuite bedroom with remodeled bathroom, a walk-in closet (updated in 2020); custom built-in barn door accessing a den (potential home office) with built-in desk, and a remodeled half bath. LG Washer/dryer in unit. Wall-to-wall carpeting throughout  Rolling Ridge also features a recently updated outdoor pool and paddle tennis courts, in addition to park-like walkways, picnic area and a fenced in dog park.The location is convenient for commuting - centrally located to Rte 7, I95, The Merritt Pkwy, train stations, public transportation, restaurants and shopping.   NOTE: HEAT & WATER are included. 2 AC wall units installed in 2020 & 2017. Large secured designated storage unit in the basement.
